North Carolina: QB Billy Edwards Jr. (hurt Nov. 14) is not on Wednesday's ACC availability report for NC State, but no starter is named between him and Travis Burgess, who started at Virginia.
NC State: RB Duke Scott was hurt again in NC State's 28-10 win at Florida State on Nov. 21; Davion Gause replaced him. No status yet for the North Carolina game.

Miami: Wednesday's ACC availability report for Boston College: WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery) upgraded from out to doubtful, CB Ja'Boree Antoine and RG Max Buchanan questionable, S Poyser probable.

Syracuse: Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli (right AC joint, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) out for Notre Dame; Malachi Nelson, who re-aggravated his ankle late in that game, starts.
Notre Dame: Notre Dame ruled out S Luke Talich (Achilles, season), LB Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa, LB Drayk Bowen and CB DJ McKinney for Syracuse; WR Jaden Greathouse (hand) is out too.

Wyoming: QB Tyler Hughes (small right forearm fracture) has missed the last two games; Landon Sims started both and no return has been announced for UConn.

Ohio State: QB Julian Sayin (right elbow) has missed four straight games since the Oct. 17 Indiana game and is not expected back for Michigan; Luke Fahey starts again.
Michigan: QB Bryce Underwood (lower body) is questionable for Ohio State on Wednesday's first Big Ten availability report; Whittingham named him the starter, Tommy Carr is No. 2.
Michigan WR J.J. Buchanan (shoulder, hurt Nov. 14 at Oregon) is out for the year, Whittingham said; he also missed the UCLA game.

Kentucky: RB1 CJ Baxter and RT Malachi Wood (lower body, hurt at Missouri) are day-to-day and likely game-time decisions vs Louisville; Will Stein said Baxter looks the worst.

Northwestern: QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) has missed 3 straight games and David Braun gave no return date this week; Nicco Marchiol has started since Nov. 8.

LSU: Leading WR Jackson Harris (lower leg, hurt Nov. 21 at Tennessee) and WR Winston Watkins Jr. are questionable for Arkansas on Wednesday's SEC availability report.

Kansas State: QB Dillon Duff is questionable for Iowa State on the Big 12 availability report after hard hits vs Arizona; Blake Barnett starts if he can't. Avery Johnson remains out.

Clemson: Dabo Swinney said backup QB Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back' for South Carolina; third-stringer Trent Pearman is in line to start again.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back for South Carolina after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II return; DT Champ Thompson is out for the season.
South Carolina: Shane Beamer said WR Mazeo Bennett Jr. and EDGE Anthony Addison, who missed the Georgia game, practiced Tuesday; CB Judge Collier (also missed Georgia) is expected ready for Clemson.

UCLA: QB Ty Dieffenbach (hip, carted off Nov. 21 at Michigan) is questionable for USC on Wednesday's Big Ten availability report; Madden Iamaleava starts if he can't.

Wake Forest: Leading rusher Ty Clark III (591 yds, 11 TD) is out for the rest of the season, Jake Dickert said Nov. 23; Deuce Lawrence takes over vs Duke.

Bowling Green: Starter Jay Kastantin (hurt Oct. 31) has missed the last two games and Eddie George said he'll probably miss the rest of the year; Austin Novosad has started both.
Massachusetts: Coach Joe Harasymiak said Nov. 24 QB Pop Watson (ankle) is 'probably not going to be able to go' at Bowling Green; Logan Inagawa starts, freshman Aedan McCarthy may also play.

Georgia: Starting C Drew Bobo (back) has missed two straight games; Kirby Smart calls him day-to-day and expects him available vs Georgia Tech. Cortez Smith starts if not.
Georgia Tech: QB Alberto Mendoza (undisclosed injury vs Wake Forest) is a game-time call for the Georgia game, Brent Key said; Grady Adamson (collarbone) is out. No. 3 Graham Knowles starts if Mendoza can't.

North Texas: North Texas starter Tayven Jackson (upper body) is out for UAB and backup Chris Jimerson Jr. (knee) is out for the season, Neal Brown confirmed; WR James Tyre took QB snaps at Tulane.

Michigan State: QB Alessio Milivojevic (left arm) is listed out on Michigan State's initial Big Ten availability report for Rutgers; freshman Kayd Coffman is in line for his 3rd start.

Indiana: Cignetti won't name a QB for Purdue: Grant Wilson started vs USC and at Washington; Josh Hoover (right shoulder since October) relieved him at Washington. Both get first-team reps.
Indiana's starting C Bray Lynch (lower leg) 'doesn't look good' for Purdue per Cignetti, and G Joe Brunner is out for the year (knee); LB Rolijah Hardy and CB A.J. Harris are also out.

Alabama: QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Chattanooga win; Kalen DeBoer said Monday he expects him back without restrictions, 'full go' all week for Auburn.
Auburn: QB Byrum Brown is questionable for Alabama on Wednesday's SEC availability report, no injury given; he played two snaps vs Samford. Tristan Ti'a starts if he can't.

Pittsburgh: With Mason Heintschel out for the season (ACL), Pat Narduzzi says this week's practice decides the Cal starter between Holden Geriner (2 INTs at Louisville) and freshman Corey Dailey.
Pitt RB Damon Ferguson Jr. (740 rushing yards, 7th in the ACC) is doubtful for the Cal game on the ACC availability report.

Houston: QB Conner Weigman (right shoulder) is questionable for Baylor on the Big 12 availability report after missing the WVU win; Fritz decides late in the week, else Keisean Henderson.

Oregon State: Oregon State QB Braden Atkinson (right hand) is out at Fresno State, his third straight missed game, JaMarcus Shephard said Monday; Maalik Murphy makes a third straight start.

Hawai'i: QB Micah Alejado (left knee, hurt at Nevada) is ruled out for the Sacramento State finale; Timmy Chang named Bjorn Jurgensen the starter, his first career start.

Texas Tech: WR Coy Eakin (missed the last 2 games) is probable on Monday's Big 12 availability report for the TCU game; Joey McGuire said Eakin and WR Micah Hudson (questionable) should be good.

Miami: Wednesday's ACC availability report for Boston College: WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery) upgraded from out to doubtful, CB Ja'Boree Antoine and RG Max Buchanan questionable, S Poyser probable.
Wake Forest: Leading rusher Ty Clark III (591 yds, 11 TD) is out for the rest of the season, Jake Dickert said Nov. 23; Deuce Lawrence takes over vs Duke.
